description: This file defines an AuthService class responsible for managing user authentication, session handling, and login procedures in a web application. It includes methods for login, session management, and wizard requirement checks, utilizing external APIs and local storage.

classes.name: AuthService
classes.description: Singleton class managing user authentication, session state, and login flow.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of AuthService.

methods.name: setSessionId
methods.description: Sets the current session ID and stores it in local storage.

methods.name: clearSession
methods.description: Clears the session ID and related local storage items.

methods.name: isAuthenticated
methods.description: Checks if the user is currently authenticated.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Performs login operation, including captcha verification, session creation, and wizard status check.

methods.name: needsWizard
methods.description: Checks if wizard setup is required based on local storage.

methods.name: clearWizardFlag
methods.description: Removes the wizard requirement flag from local storage.
